text:
Sam (recruiter): Offer flagged for Maya (senior infra). Candidate asking 2026-06-15 start, relocating from EU. Manager requests $7k sign-on and a provisional +4% uplift to base; wants benefits effective day 1. Can we route an exception?
Priya (people-ops): Please post a one-line summary of asks + business justification. Also need timeline for docs.
Sam (recruiter): Summary: sign-on $7k (one-time), uplift +4% (within band but over auto threshold), day-1 benefits. Rationale: counteroffer risk, key infra hire, manager says 3-month impact if we lose candidate. Candidate can provide address + passport by 6/1.
Elaine (comp): +4% needs comp review sign-off (policy: up to 3% auto). Upload manager memo and budget owner approval.
Mike (finance): Finance needs GL code and confirmation headcount is open. One-time sign-on can come from hiring budget if leader ok. Mark GL 5012.
Anna (legal): For day-1 benefits we add a short clause about carrier rules and enrollment timing. I can draft language if People Ops confirms approval.
Chandra (onboarding): Note: benefits team requires 72h feed. For international starts we need proof of address + ID by 6/08 to meet 6/15 start. If docs late, benefits effective date may shift.
OnboardBot: Reminder: benefits feed cutoff = 2026-06-12. Escalate to benefits-team if docs missing.
Priya (people-ops): Routing plan: Manager -> Comp (Elaine) -> Finance (Mike) -> People Ops final. Legal + Onboarding looped for offer language and enrollment logistics. Target decision by 2026-06-05.
Sam (recruiter): Uploaded manager memo and budget approval note. Tagging @Elaine @Mike.
Elaine (comp): Reviewing memo now. If memo shows competitive offer and business impact, I can sign off on +4% with finance approval.
Mike (finance): Finance provisional ok pending formal headcount entry.
Anna (legal): Draft clause: "Benefits eligibility will begin on the employee's start date pending carrier rules and timely verification of required documents." Will add to template.
Priya (people-ops): Great — once comp + finance sign, People Ops will approve sign-on and day-1 benefits. Sam, please confirm candidate docs ETA.
Sam (recruiter): Candidate committed to provide docs by 2026-06-03. Will update here. :thumbsup:
